summary_en: This Phase 2 study randomly assigns Veterans with castrate-sensitive prostate cancer to first-line treatment with abiraterone acetate, enzalutamide, or apalutamide. All three drugs are taken by mouth once daily, and abiraterone is taken with a steroid (methylprednisolone or prednisone). The record does not state how long treatment lasts, and it does not state a main outcome measure; the study is listed as Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 asigna de forma aleatoria a veteranos con cáncer de próstata sensible a la castración a un tratamiento de primera línea con acetato de abiraterona, enzalutamida o apalutamida. Los tres medicamentos se toman por vía oral una vez al día, y la abiraterona se toma con un esteroide (metilprednisolona o prednisona). El registro no indica cuánto dura el tratamiento ni establece una medida de resultado principal; el estudio figura como fase 2.
who_for: Veterans who can give written informed consent
ECOG performance status of 2 or less
Confirmed prostate adenocarcinoma without small-cell features
Androgen-deprivation therapy started within 120 days before randomization, planned, or prior bilateral orchiectomy
not_for: Prior chemotherapy or prostate cancer treatment with abiraterone, apalutamide, enzalutamide, darolutamide, aminoglutethimide, or ketoconazole, except placebo
History of seizure or conditions that may predispose to seizure
Receiving other investigational agents at the same time
Child-Pugh Class B or C liver disease
